content:
Today Apple released iOS 27 and its accompanying updates, which include two major improvements to the HomePod 27 software.

HomePod 27 adds Apple Music's AutoMix feature, improved AirPlay performance, and multiple bug fixes

HomePod 27 is the latest software update for HomePod. You can install it through the Home app on your iPhone by going to "Home Settings" → "Software Update".

Below is Apple's official HomePod 27 update notes:

In addition to bug fixes and security updates, HomePod 27 includes two important changes:

  • Apple Music AutoMix feature
  • Faster AirPlay connection speed

AutoMix was first introduced on iOS last year, but this year the feature has been further enhanced and expanded to HomePod and Apple TV.

With AutoMix, transitions between songs become more like what you'd hear when a DJ is controlling the mix at a party or venue. Since HomePod provides music for the entire home, this feature is a perfect match for it.

The AirPlay improvements may sound trivial, but in actual use, they can significantly reduce the time it takes to connect to HomePod. During the iOS 27 beta period, I found that switching playback between my iPhone and HomePod is faster and easier than before, which is genuinely surprising.

HomePod 27 does not include Siri AI. However, we expect this feature to debut in new HomePod hardware updates expected to launch in about a month.
